source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Dashboard"
And also enter "Server Health" -> "Sensor Reading"

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor Reading & Threshold is human reable and match with spec.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES submits `TEMP_PSU1~6` as one literal record and cannot prove six slot readings. It does not establish fitted population, bind each sensor to a bay and module serial/model, identify the PMBus temperature channel, or define mixed-model, standby and absent-slot acceptance.

V3.1 adds per-bay AC-feed and capacity identity, mixed-model field/limit selection and survivor/redundancy context, while keeping this row passive and distinct from the two-module CRPS family.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 893/2291 accepts a literal six-item range and output presence without physical bay/serial/model/PMBus mapping, fitted-slot semantics, power-sharing context or complete threshold/UI evidence.

historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves PSU1-6 labels; ED-34 treats fitted-slot/model/PMBus-field/specification as readiness; ED-35 keeps this passive without hot-swap, feed/load/redundancy or thermal stimulus; ED-38 requires protected complete evidence, no clear/write/retry and engineer-owned verdict. original_test_intent: Verify the `TEMP_PSU1` through `TEMP_PSU6` records correspond to the six defined power-supply bays and that every fitted module is individually readable in Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading with the correct module identity, PMBus temperature point, value, units, status and thresholds; defined empty bays must be represented as specified.
original_method: Build the authoritative six-bay population map, bind each sensor index to bay, module serial/model, AC feed and PMBus page/object, then compare complete passive raw/UI fields with the applicable model and field limits under recorded load distribution, redundancy and cooling. Preserve power, BMC and event state.
manual_activity: The power owner approves the six-bay fitted/empty matrix, maps every installed module by bay, serial, model, feed and PMBus field, and supplies model-specific rules. Automation can collect the passive records, inventory and UI rows; a human confirms physical population and redundancy context and owns the verdict. No PSU service or power/load change is authorized.
required_inputs: Chassis/power-subsystem PN/revision, BMC build and six-bay PSU definition distinct from CRPS1/2
Per-bay AC feed, PN/serial/HW/FW/capacity, fitted/empty and active/standby/load-share state
Vendor PMBus reference for every installed model with controller/bus/mux/address/page/command and exact temperature field
Stable SDR and Dashboard/Server Health identity for PSU1 through PSU6
Per-model/field units, scaling, tolerance, thresholds/hysteresis, status, polling and unavailable/stale rules
Acceptance for empty bays, mixed models, capacity mismatch, degraded redundancy and asymmetric load sharing
Recorded system power, per-module input/output/current/load, fan speeds, ambient and airflow
Validated protected ipmitool/API/browser access and pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or manual method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, kernel, PSU black-box or PMBus history; existing power/thermal evidence must remain intact.
Do not issue `sensor get 'TEMP_PSU1~6'` as a wildcard. Enumerate the six defined records and explicitly distinguish fitted, empty and unavailable bays.
Do not assume identical PSU models, fields or limits across bays and do not equate this family with CRPS1/2; bind each reading to serial and PMBus page/object.
Treat PMBus/I2C/I3C as BMC/platform-management scope; host bus discovery does not prove a particular PSU or field.
Do not hot-remove/reseat modules, disconnect AC feeds, change load/redundancy, start power stress, alter fans/thresholds or write PMBus. Record the current power state only.

Do not truncate inventory, expose passwords with `-P`, assume cipher 17 or execute the inaccessible Script. Stop without automatic retry on unexpected population, swapped slots, stale data or BMC/UI/PMBus disagreement.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the six-bay population, module/model/feed/PMBus maps, target, client, vendor references and Script; create a fitted/empty expectation matrix.
Query each defined PSU sensor separately with full SDR/PMBus identity, temperature-field meaning, value, units, supported thresholds, status and timestamp; capture corresponding unchanged UI entries.
Correlate every result with passive inventory, module capacity/load-share/redundancy and recorded power/fan/ambient/airflow conditions; apply the correct model/field limit.
Preserve raw/redacted evidence and logs; perform no clear, hot-swap, AC/load/redundancy, fan/threshold/PMBus write, automatic retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the six-bay fitted/empty population and per-bay serial/feed/PMBus-field map, separate from CRPS coverage.
Provide per-model/field acceptance, mixed-population and degraded/empty rules; approve the protected read-only tool/Script.
Review each fitted bay and every defined empty-bay response independently and issue the formal verdict without accepting a count or sample.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unfit as written because tilde shorthand is not an IPMI wildcard and one response cannot prove six bay records. It omits population/model/serial/feed/PMBus-field and redundancy mapping, truncates fallback data, exposes credentials and assumes cipher support.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate all six defined records, map each fitted module and empty bay, query through protected read-only access, and correlate complete UI/PMBus evidence with per-model, per-field acceptance.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_PSU1~6, both WebUI paths, readability/specification Criteria, generic clear text, Script URL, DeepSeek commands and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; Review expands the range without editing Master or changing the power subsystem.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a six-bay matrix keyed by bay, serial/model/feed and PMBus page/object, explicitly recording fitted/empty and load-share state, then compare complete raw/API and UI fields with the correct per-model/field specification under unchanged operating conditions.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact six-bay PSU population and BMC/PMBus/SDR/WebUI build documented by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/power-subsystem, BMC, each PSU HW/FW/PMBus revision, WebUI/SDR, management client and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Power-bay and AC-feed wiring map, PSU inventory, vendor PMBus specifications for all fitted models, BMC SDR definition, WebUI schema and Project power recipe.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Resolves the range into six bay- and module-bound outcomes including empty bays and model-specific fields, while preserving passive display coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Static PSU temperatures do not validate hot-swap, N+N/N+1 redundancy, load sharing, efficiency, AC loss, black-box logging, threshold events or shutdown behavior.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Six-bay population/model/PMBus map, state-specific acceptance, passive sampling timing, protected tool or reviewed Script and evidence contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Mixed PSU models can expose different channels and thresholds; empty or standby bay behavior is platform-defined, and dashboard polling can lag raw PMBus state.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use Redfish/OEM or vendor PMBus tooling as an approved alternative/corroboration only while preserving the original ipmitool method, recording interface/version/page/object and reason, obtaining engineer approval and proving equivalent per-bay identity, temperature field, value, threshold, status and freshness coverage. CRPS telemetry or aggregate PSU health is not automatically equivalent.
expected_evidence: Chassis/power-subsystem PN/revision, BMC and authoritative six-bay fitted/empty matrix with per-bay feed/PN/serial/HW/FW/capacity/state
Per-model vendor PMBus references plus controller/bus/mux/address/page/command and temperature-field mapping
Complete separate raw records for all defined bays with stable IDs, values or defined unavailable state, units, threshold capabilities/values, status and timestamps plus redacted UI rows
Recorded system and per-module power/load-share/redundancy, fan/ambient/airflow state with model- and field-specific comparisons

Explicit missing/swapped/mixed-model/empty/degraded/stale/divergent disposition, pinned Script/tool evidence, no-clear/no-hot-swap/no-feed-or-load-change/no-retry proof, final PSU/BMC health and engineer-owned six-bay verdict

review_improvement: Prevents a failed range query, partial population, wrong model limit or CRPS sensor from being presented as six PSU temperatures, and prevents hot-swap or power/load manipulation from being added to a passive UI test.
independent_technical_reasoning: A six-bay power shelf can be partially populated or contain multiple PSU revisions, and PMBus temperature channels may differ by model. Valid evidence must therefore be bay- and serial-bound, preserve defined empty-bay behavior and use the correct field limits under the recorded load-sharing state. Static display coverage does not authorize redundancy testing.
